title: sohum.geoziptag.team_member/1
description: A signed-in member of a team, as the console lists it. The only personal identifier GeoZipTag stores for this is the SoHum account id, shown masked; no name or email is kept here. The row is kept as removed (not deleted) for the audit, and erased when the account is deleted. See docs/GEOZIPTAG_ENTITLEMENT_SHAPE.md.

account_id_masked.description: First four and last four characters of the SoHum account id.
